name: Payment directed to personal or third-party account
description: Payment is requested to, or credited to, a personal, third-party or differently named account rather than the contracted payee.
fp: Factoring, assignment, or legitimate account changes.

links.name: Payment requested in cash or to personal account
links.ctx: Intermediary asks that fees be paid in cash, via third parties, or into a personal rather than corporate account.

links.name: Rapid bank account changes or payments to unrelated accounts for suppliers
links.ctx: Supplier asks to redirect payments to accounts held by third parties, often after award.

links.name: Payments from claims to unrelated third parties
links.ctx: Claim proceeds are redirected via mule accounts.

links.name: Refund or benefit credited to account of different name
links.ctx: Payee name does not match the recipient listed.
